يصطفوا (form VIII)
# يَصْطَفُوا (yaṣṭafū) /jasˤ.tˤa.fuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِصْطَفَى (iṣṭafā)
# يُصْطَفَوْا (yuṣṭafaw) /jusˤ.tˤa.faw/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِصْطَفَى (iṣṭafā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
